messages.subject: Adding auxiliary variables with semTools

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Adding auxiliary variables with semTools
parts:
The script looks correct.  It looks like the warning messages are all due to the massive lack of data.  The warnings from auxiliary() are the same as the warnings from cfa() -- you can get rid of one of them by just deleting the rows of data that don't have any information to contributed (100% missing).  But the error from auxiliary() indicates it can't calculate a Cholesky decomposition of a matrix -- because it's an error, I'm guessing that means you can't get any output from auxiliary() in this instance.  What kind of planned missing design generated this data?  It seems there must have been a lot of unplanned missingness on top of the planned missingness.

Terry

messages.author: e76612751d0fd653
messages.subject: Re: Adding auxiliary variables with semTools
parts:
Terry,

Thank you for confirming my script. You are correct I am not getting any output from auxiliary(). This was a ten form planned missingness and while all the auxiliary variables were core variables with minimal missingness, all my variables of interest have a lot of missing data, so much so, along with my sample size of 350, MCMC wasn't running which is why I am using FIML. I also have negative eigenvalues that I am trying to correct. Do you have any suggestions for tweaks to help this auxiliary() issue?

Thanks!
